text:
aline_sales: Heads up 10x FinCorp LATAM wants a narrow-scope POC: Frankfurt + Se3o Paulo only, tenant-level BYO-KMS, strict static egress IPs, and a conservative monthly cost estimate. They also ask for 95th <100ms from both regions. Can we support?

peter_presales: Sounds doable but need confirmation on regional dedicated capacity and whether partner infra in BR is a subprocessor.

jo_infra: We can provision dedicated slices in eu-central-1 and the partner colo in sa-east-1. Partner must be disclosed as subproc. Static egress IPs can be reserved per-tenant; lead time ~3 business days for EU, ~5 for BR.

sam_security: BYO-KMS ok if calls are mTLS, and customer provides endpoint IPs and cert chain. Will need their SOC/ISO docs for subproc listing. Also confirm they do not want any key material persisted.

leo_ops: Quick ballpark: 4-week POC ~ $10k (two reserved GPU slices + reserved NATs), steady-state ~ $9k/mo + egress. Egress estimates: BR $0.10/GB, EU $0.03/GB. Static egress IP reserve fee ~$600/mo for /24-equivalent. If they require no cross-region fallback add one-time config fee $2k.

claire_legal: If disabling global fallback we need a contractual routing exception and risk acknowledgement. I'll prep a short template.

aline_sales: Action items: Peter to request KMS IPs and attestation; Leo to produce 1-page quote and include 10TB example; Jo to confirm exact CIDRs and lead times; Claire to draft routing exception. Back to customer after KMS info. :thumbsup:
